title: Appearance: WCAG contrast audit on pane + Theme Expert proposals
body:
Add a WCAG 2 contrast audit to the theme system, surfaced in the Appearance pane and on Theme Expert proposal cards. It is a REPORT, never a gate: Apply / Save as new stay enabled whatever the result. Read docs/theme-system.md first.

## What to build

1. Pure audit in a NEW file src/contrast.rs (register `mod contrast;` in src/main.rs; theme.rs is already 1.3k lines). A static PAIRS table in the style of theme::TOKENS: foreground token, background token, Kind::Text (AA bar 4.5:1) or Kind::Ui (3.0:1). Standard WCAG 2 relative-luminance formula. Translucent tokens (selection, search_match, search_current, caret, scroll_thumb) are composited over `bg` first; stored bytes are PREMULTIPLIED, so out = src + dst*(1-a). `audit(&Theme) -> Audit` returns every pair's ratio + tier and a count below its bar.
   Pairs: fg, dim, palette[1..=15] on bg (Text; skip palette[0] — a background slot). text on win_bg, title_bg, title_bg_focus; dim on title_bg_focus. chat_colors[0..6], chat_live, chat_stale, chat_edge on bg. danger, search_error on bg. fg on selection-over-bg and on search_current-over-bg (Text). caret-over-bg vs bg and border_focus vs bg (Ui). Skip hover states, scrim, snap_*, chrome_*, plain border.
2. Pane (src/appearance.rs): a chip in the status line under the preset row reading e.g. "Contrast: 2 below AA" (or "Contrast: AA" when clean). Token-row hover tooltip gains one line per pair the token is the FOREGROUND of ("on bg 13.8:1 AAA", "on selection 9.2:1 AAA"); tokens that are never a foreground get no extra line. House style: hand-painted chips/rows, colours from theme::live tokens, no literals.
3. Proposal card (src/appearance.rs, src/theme_expert.rs): header shows the delta vs the request's base theme, e.g. "fixes 2 · breaks 1" (omit when both are 0). Computed locally from the scope-merged proposal — never from anything the model says.
4. Theme Expert prompt (theme_expert::build_prompt): append the base theme's failing pairs (fg key, bg key, ratio, bar) as context. Add a "Fix contrast" starter chip beside appearance::STARTERS, shown only when the base theme has failures.

## Known baseline (Foreman Warm)
fg/bg 13.8, dim/bg 5.8, dim/title_bg_focus 4.0 (below), palette[8]/bg 3.5 (below). Those two known misses are expected; do not retune the built-in to hide them.

## Acceptance
- Unit tests in src/contrast.rs: white-on-black = 21.0; foreman_warm fg/bg ≈ 13.8; a premultiplied-alpha composite case; every PAIRS key is a real TOKENS key / palette / chat_colors index; a snapshot test of which built-in pairs fall below bar.
- Existing tests still green; no new dependencies; no hard-coded colour literals in new paint code.
- GUI verified by the user's build-screenshot skill — ask, do not claim.
- Update docs/theme-system.md (How to use it + Key files) with the audit.

## Gate
cargo build --target-dir target/agent
cargo test --target-dir target/agent
(The integration queue runs the full `cargo test`; run the same. `cargo test contrast` for the fast loop.)
You are INSIDE foreman (FOREMAN=1): never Stop-Process foreman; build only with --target-dir target/agent.
